realtime_memories.content: Turborepo monorepo with 10 subdomain apps (www, thoughts, dev, links, updates, metrics, status, lab, docs, cli) and shared packages (ui, lib, types, config, styles). All 9 subdomains import from @anipotts/ui; www keeps local window components. Shared packages built with tsup. Three-layer shared system: @anipotts/lib (plain helpers) → @anipotts/ui (client components with callback props) → per-app actions.ts (thin 'use server' wrappers). GitHub: https://github.com/anipotts/anipotts.com.

Required env vars: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_HOST, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ADMIN_PASSWORD, GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_USERNAME, WAKATIME_API_KEY, CRON_SECRET. Dev: 'pnpm turbo dev --concurrency=15'. Build shared: 'pnpm --filter @anipotts/lib build && pnpm --filter @anipotts/ui build'. Vercel: pnpm 10.x, each app has its own vercel.json. All 9 subdomains deployed to Vercel with custom domains.

Accent: #61ABEA (blue). Handles: @anipottsbuilds (social), @anipotts (GitHub/LinkedIn). Email: contact@anipotts.com. Bio: 'minimal interfaces to orchestrate complex systems'. Terminal header: 'ani@potts:~/[domain]' with responsive prefix hiding. Font: JetBrains Mono. Design tokens in packages/styles/src/tokens.css.

Shared data in @anipotts/lib with tsup multi-entry builds. Modules: data/ (projects, social, site, services), admin/ (auth, thoughts CRUD), metrics/ (GitHub stats/languages/commits, WakaTime, Supabase cache), status/ (HTTP checker, Supabase persistence). Supabase tables: thoughts, metrics_cache (key-value JSONB), status_checks, favorite_numbers. Vercel Crons: metrics daily 6AM UTC, status every 5 min. Import Supabase via @anipotts/lib/supabase to avoid pnpm version mismatches.

.gitignore includes .turbo and next-env.d.ts. tsconfig uses jsx: preserve. SEO: robots.txt, sitemap.ts, Person schema, OG cards. Headshot: /images/ani-potts-headshot.png. SubdomainNavigator (Ctrl+`) on www shows all 9 subdomains with SSH config aesthetic. Admin accessed via Cmd+Shift+A, cookie-based auth per domain.

7-phase ecosystem unification completed: (1) shared data layer, (2) shared admin system with dependency inversion, (3) real metrics from GitHub+WakaTime APIs with cron, (4) real HTTP status monitoring with cron, (5) dynamic dev page with GitHub language bar + updates page with real commit activity, (6) lab/docs cleanup removing broken links and fake content, (7) www integration with updated SubdomainNavigator statuses. All apps typecheck cleanly.
